title: SLI Sample Store & Prioritized Evaluation Hub
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Create a centralized SLI Sample Store and Prioritized Evaluation Hub to capture raw SLI events, synthetic traffic outputs, and prioritized evaluation manifests. The store is intended to: 1) provide deterministic inputs for SLI/SLO regression tests and root-cause investigations, 2) enable prioritized, reproducible evaluation runs (randomized + targeted), and 3) feed the Console and Optimize features with canonical samples for quality monitoring and alert triage. This reduces noisy SLO alerts, accelerates incident RCA, and makes rollout regressions actionable.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest SLI event stream at sustained 2k events/sec with spikes to 10k for 5m without lost samples
Retention and TTL policies configurable per-customer and per-metric, default 90 days
Schema versioning and backward compatibility for stored samples
Query API supports 7-day queries under 200ms 95th percentile for common predicates
Console integration: SLI sample explorer surface for any SLO with 'download sample' and 're-run evaluation' buttons
Prioritized evaluation manifests: ability to define weighted sample sets and run deterministic eval jobs
RBAC applied: only authorized roles can export raw samples or run customer-scoped evals
End-to-end e2e test and runbook exist; rollout plan includes canary, metrics to monitor, and rollback criteria
tasks: Finalize PRD and data model (schema v1) - link in links
Engineering spike to compare ClickHouse vs BigQuery for query latency/cost
Prototype ingestion pipeline: Kafka -> Flink -> ClickHouse (PoC)
Retention manager and storage tiering implementation
Query API and GraphQL facade for Console
Console UI surface: sample explorer + eval job launcher (Design collaboration)
Synthetic job registry: store configs for reproducible synthetic traffic runs

Runbook, docs, and migration communication plan to customers
